title: Math & logic building
learn: digit extraction (% 10, // 10), reversing numbers, GCD (Euclid), primes (sieve), overflow awareness
hook: Palindrome Number and Reverse Integer are some of the most common warm-up questions. They test whether you can manipulate numbers without reaching for strings.

explain.prompt: Explain how to reverse the digits of an integer without converting it to a string, and what the complexity is.
keyPoints: x % 10 gives the last digit, x // 10 removes it
build the result with rev = rev * 10 + digit
number of iterations = number of digits = O(log₁₀ n)
handle the sign separately; watch for 32-bit overflow in fixed-width languages
